auditQuestions.whatCreatesObservations: Data Reality / RDI create business observations (KPI results, source snapshots, monitoring observedAt). CORE-OUT:1A captures those observations into Outcome-eligible records. EI:6 observeActualOutcome and STAGE-PROD:5 append APIs exist but are not live writers. CORE-OUT:1A is the live capture/linkage writer.
auditQuestions.whatContainsTimestamps: RDI observedAt/importedAt, KPI calculatedAt, monitoring observedAt. Live CORE-OUT expected capturedAt remains null. Decision/execution commitment timestamps are not present on the live nex-mvp path.
auditQuestions.whatContainsProvenance: RDI source provenance, Data Reality advisor/stage provenance chains, CORE-OUT:1 actuals provenanceRefs. CORE-OUT:1A requires sourceId, datasetId, and provenanceRefs for validated Actual Outcome.
auditQuestions.whatContainsDatasetSourceIdentity: RDI sourceId/connectionId/snapshot. KPI kpiId/objectKey/nexoraObjectId. CORE-OUT:1A preserves sourceId and datasetId.
auditQuestions.canLinkToSubjects: Yes via nexoraObjectId / object keys / fixture subject ids. That is Reality linkage, not Outcome linkage.
auditQuestions.canLinkDecisionToExpected: Yes. Live expected uses expectationId expected:{scenarioId} from scenario/decision fixture summaries as PREDICTION.
auditQuestions.canLinkExecutionWithoutCc11: Fixture/contextual subject links only. CC:11 remains unwired. Execution timing is unavailable on the live path.
auditQuestions.observationWindowExists: CORE-OUT:1 had a thin ExecutiveOutcomeWindow. CORE-OUT:1A now owns OutcomeObservationWindowRecord. Windows are created only from real Decision/Execution timestamps or explicit measurement periods. Live fixtures have no such timestamps, so windows are timing-incomplete and are not fabricated.
auditQuestions.recentChangeTemporalEvidence: Monitoring/change can supply timestamps. Recent Change is not Outcome unless the observations themselves are canonical and an explicit Outcome link exists.
auditQuestions.missingForOutcomeEvidence: Explicit Outcome linkage, compatible dimension+unit, valid window membership, provenance, validation, and a writer that does not treat current KPI as Outcome. CORE-OUT:1A supplies capture+linkage. CORE-OUT:1 still evaluates.
